## BugXploit Ethical Hacking & Penetration Testing Workshop
- **Overview & Syllabus:** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/
- **Training Institution:** BugXploit (Koteshwor, Kathmandu, Nepal - https://bugxploit.com/)
- **Author & Documenter:** Chandan Kumar Thakur (TheWH2)
- **Instructors:**
  - Birendra Sah (Cybersecurity Specialist): https://www.linkedin.com/in/birendrasah4u2/
  - Bishal Shrestha (Security Researcher & Red Teamer): https://www.linkedin.com/in/bishal0x01/
- **Curriculum:** 14 intensive sessions in network security, web application auditing, privilege escalation, and modern AI attack surfaces.

### Session Index
- **Day 1 (Lab Setup & Virtualization):** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/day1/ - VirtualBox, Kali Linux, Metasploitable 2 lab topology, host discovery via Nmap (`nmap -sn`), and Bugcrowd scope guidelines.
- **Day 2 (Service Exploitation & Backdoors):** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/day2/ - VSFTPD 2.3.4 Backdoor exploitation (CVE-2011-2523), Telnet cleartext sniffing, and Metasploit SSH brute-force (`auxiliary/scanner/ssh/ssh_login`).
- **Day 3 (OSINT & Target Intelligence):** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/day3/ - Passive reconnaissance, Tesla Bugcrowd scope, Google Dorking, DNSDumpster, crt.sh certificate logs, WHOIS, Emkei email spoof analysis, and Shodan.
- **Day 4 (Command Injection & CSRF):** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/day4/ - DVWA command injection, Netcat reverse shells (`nc -lvnp`), PHP source code auditing of `security.php`, Burp Suite proxy interception, and automated CSRF exploitation.
- **Day 5 (SQLMap & Cross-Site Scripting):** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/day5/ - Burp Intruder Sniper, automated database dumping via SQLMap (`--dbs`, `-T users --dump`), Reflected & Stored XSS, and cookie stealing via Webhook.site.
- **Day 6 (Automated Scanning & Secret Hunting):** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/day6/ - ProjectDiscovery Nuclei scanning, PHP-CGI CVE-2012-1823, Samba CVE-2026-4480, GitHub dorking, streaak/keyhacks API validation, and TruffleHog.
- **Day 7 (Android App Pentesting):** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/day7/ - Oracle JDK 26 & JADX-GUI decompilation, MobSF static security auditing of DivaApplication.apk, Janus vulnerability (CVE-2017-13156), and hardcoded key extraction.
- **Day 8 (PortSwigger Authentication Flaws):** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/day8/ - Username enumeration via subtle response-length differences with Burp Intruder, JSON multi-credential rate-limit bypass, 2FA cookie flaws, and password reset poisoning via X-Forwarded-Host header injection.
- **Day 9 (Web LLM Attacks & Prompt Injection):** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/day9/ - PortSwigger Web LLM Attacks, Direct Prompt Injection, LLM API exploitation with Excessive Agency, extracting database schema via LLM function calls (`Debug SQL`), and Indirect Prompt Injection via product reviews to hijack live user sessions.

- **Day 10 (Live Bug Hunting & Reconnaissance):** https://knowledge.chandankumarthakur.com.np/ethical-hacking-and-penetration-testing/day10/ - Live bug bounty methodology on HackerOne (Sony VDP), corporate entity mapping via Crunchbase, DNS enumeration via DNSDumpster, HTML injection & XSS testing, advanced Google Dorks, JWT decoding via JWT.io, URL redirect parameter tampering, and disposable email isolation using Temp-Mail.
